in_sanskrit.meaning: One who is devoted to Rama

in_hindi.meaning: One who is endowed with Bharat (India)
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is proud of being an Indian and is endowed with the qualities and virtues of Bharat, the ancient name of India.

in_marathi.name: Bharathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharathi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharatha' which means 'bringer of joy'. It is also associated with the Goddess Saraswati, the Hindu deity of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning.
